"""Create one private non-networked MySQL instance and verify cleanup unconditionally."""

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

START = time.monotonic()
ROOT = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-support-20261021/fastapi_be")
OUTPUT = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-source-first-mysql-attempt-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12] + ".json")
WORKER = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-source-mysql-first-worker.py")
NAME = "hoim-operations-source-first-mysql-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
LABEL = "hoim.operations.source=" + NAME
work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hoim-operations-source-first-mysql-private-"))
socket_dir = work / "socket"
socket_dir.mkdir()
socket_dir.chmod(0o777)
worker_copy = work / "worker.py"
shutil.copyfile(WORKER, worker_copy)
worker_result = work / "worker-result.json"
report = {
    "image": "mysql:8.0.39",
    "container_name": NAME,
    "synthetic_only": True,
    "network": "none",
    "host_ports": [],
    "source_mounts": False,
    "existing_database_accessed": False,
    "project_env_file_read": False,
    "scope": "Private MySQL four additive governed operations source tables; actual incremental up/down/up and every old DDL/row hash, current authority and direct/Source concurrency. No historical migration chain replay, HTTP/model/hospital claim.",
}


def guard(event, args):
    if event == "open" and args and isinstance(args[0], (str, bytes)):
        name = Path(os.fsdecode(args[0])).name
        if name == ".env" or name.startswith(".env."):
            raise RuntimeError("Dotenv forbidden in isolated MySQL runner")
    if event == "socket.getaddrinfo":
        raise RuntimeError("DNS forbidden in isolated MySQL runner")
    if event == "socket.connect" and args[1] != str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock"):
        raise RuntimeError("Only this newly created private Unix socket is allowed")


sys.addaudithook(guard)


def run(args, **kwargs):
    return subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True, **kwargs)


try:
    image = json.loads(run(["docker", "image", "inspect", "mysql:8.0.39"], check=True).stdout)[0]
    report["image_id"] = image["Id"]
    init = "mysqld --initialize-insecure --datadir=/var/lib/mysql --innodb-buffer-pool-size=32M --innodb-redo-log-capacity=16777216 --log-error-verbosity=2 && exec mysqld --datadir=/var/lib/mysql --socket=/socket/mysql.sock --pid-file=/socket/mysql.pid --skip-networking --mysqlx=0 --skip-log-bin --performance-schema=OFF --innodb-buffer-pool-size=32M --innodb-redo-log-capacity=16777216 --secure-file-priv=NULL --log-error-verbosity=2"
    args = [
        "docker",
        "run",
        "-d",
        "--name",
        NAME,
        "--label",
        LABEL,
        "--network",
        "none",
        "--read-only",
        "--cap-drop",
        "ALL",
        "--security-opt",
        "no-new-privileges",
        "--user",
        "999:999",
        "--memory",
        "768m",
        "--cpus",
        "1",
        "--pids-limit",
        "128",
        "--tmpfs",
        "/var/lib/mysql:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=512m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0700",
        "--tmpfs",
        "/tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=64m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0700",
        "--mount",
        "type=bind,src=" + str(socket_dir) + ",dst=/socket",
        "--entrypoint",
        "sh",
        "mysql:8.0.39",
        "-c",
        init,
    ]
    run(args, check=True)
    info = json.loads(run(["docker", "inspect", NAME], check=True).stdout)[0]
    assert info["HostConfig"]["NetworkMode"] == "none" and not info["HostConfig"]["PortBindings"]
    assert info["HostConfig"]["ReadonlyRootfs"] and info["Config"]["User"] == "999:999"
    assert not any(m["Type"] == "volume" for m in info["Mounts"])
    report["isolation"] = {
        "network_mode": info["HostConfig"]["NetworkMode"],
        "port_bindings": info["HostConfig"]["PortBindings"],
        "readonly_root": True,
        "user": info["Config"]["User"],
        "cap_drop": info["HostConfig"]["CapDrop"],
        "tmpfs": info["HostConfig"]["Tmpfs"],
        "mount_types": [m["Type"] for m in info["Mounts"]],
    }
    import pymysql

    connection = None
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 75
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if (
            not run(
                ["docker", "inspect", "--format", "{{.State.Running}}", NAME],
                check=True,
            ).stdout.strip()
            == "true"
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Private MySQL exited during initialization: " + run(["docker", "logs", "--tail", "25", NAME]).stdout + run(["docker", "logs", "--tail", "25", NAME]).stderr)
        try:
            connection = pymysql.connect(
                unix_socket=str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock"),
                user="root",
                charset="utf8mb4",
                connect_timeout=1,
                autocommit=True,
            )
            break
        except (pymysql.err.OperationalError, FileNotFoundError):
            time.sleep(0.25)
    if connection is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Private MySQL did not become ready within bounded initialization wait")
    with connection:
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("CREATE DATABASE hoim_synthetic_operations_source CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci")
    report["waited_for_final_mysql_initialization"] = True
    env = {
        "PATH": "/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin",
        "LANG": "C.UTF-8",
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        "DATABASE_URL": "mysql+pymysql://root@localhost/hoim_synthetic_operations_source?unix_socket=" + str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock") + "&charset=utf8mb4",
        "ENVIRONMENT": "test",
        "SECRET_KEY": "synthetic-supply-migration-only-" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
        "AUTO_CREATE_SCHEMA": "false",
        "SCHEDULER_ENABLED": "false",
    }
    result = run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            str(worker_copy),
            str(ROOT),
            str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock"),
            str(worker_result),
        ],
        cwd=work,
        env=env,
        timeout=600,
    )
    if worker_result.exists():
        report.update(json.loads(worker_result.read_text()))
    report["worker_exit_code"] = result.returncode
    report["worker_stdout"] = result.stdout[-2000:]
    report["worker_stderr"] = result.stderr[-4000:]
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("Verification worker failed; see recorded worker stderr and error")
    report["verification_script_sha256"] = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [Path(__file__), WORKER]}
except BaseException as exc:
    report["all_checks_passed"] = False
    report["runner_error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}
finally:
    removed = run(["docker", "rm", "-f", "-v", NAME])
    absent = run(["docker", "inspect", NAME]).returncode != 0
    own_volumes = run(
        [
            "docker",
            "volume",
            "ls",
            "--filter",
            "label=" + LABEL,
            "--format",
            "{{.Name}}",
        ]
    ).stdout.strip()
    shutil.rmtree(work)
    report["own_container_absent_verified"] = absent
    report["own_container_and_volumes_removed"] = absent and not own_volumes
    report["own_private_directory_removed"] = not work.exists()
    report["cleanup_verified"] = report["own_container_and_volumes_removed"] and report["own_private_directory_removed"]
    report["verification_scripts_retained_in_tmp"] = [str(Path(__file__)), str(WORKER)]
    report["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - START, 3)
    report["completed_at_utc"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat()
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
if report.get("all_checks_passed") and report["cleanup_verified"]:
    final = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-source-first-mysql-verification.json")
    assert not final.exists(), "Do not overwrite existing final bed MySQL evidence"
    shutil.copyfile(OUTPUT, final)
print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "artifact": str(OUTPUT),
            "all_checks_passed": report.get("all_checks_passed"),
            "cleanup_verified": report["cleanup_verified"],
            "seconds": report["seconds"],
            "runner_error": report.get("runner_error"),
            "error": report.get("error"),
        },
        ensure_ascii=False,
    )
)
sys.exit(0 if report.get("all_checks_passed") and report["cleanup_verified"] else 1)

"""Create one private non-networked MySQL instance and verify cleanup unconditionally."""

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

START = time.monotonic()
ROOT = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-support-20261021/fastapi_be")
OUTPUT = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-source-second-mysql-attempt-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12] + ".json")
WORKER = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-source-mysql-second-worker.py")
NAME = "hoim-operations-source-second-mysql-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
LABEL = "hoim.operations.source=" + NAME
work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hoim-operations-source-second-mysql-private-"))
socket_dir = work / "socket"
socket_dir.mkdir()
socket_dir.chmod(0o777)
worker_copy = work / "worker.py"
shutil.copyfile(WORKER, worker_copy)
worker_result = work / "worker-result.json"
report = {
    "image": "mysql:8.0.39",
    "container_name": NAME,
    "synthetic_only": True,
    "network": "none",
    "host_ports": [],
    "source_mounts": False,
    "existing_database_accessed": False,
    "project_env_file_read": False,
    "scope": "Private MySQL four additive governed operations source tables; actual incremental up/down/up and every old DDL/row hash, current authority and direct/Source concurrency. No historical migration chain replay, HTTP/model/hospital claim.",
}


def guard(event, args):
    if event == "open" and args and isinstance(args[0], (str, bytes)):
        name = Path(os.fsdecode(args[0])).name
        if name == ".env" or name.startswith(".env."):
            raise RuntimeError("Dotenv forbidden in isolated MySQL runner")
    if event == "socket.getaddrinfo":
        raise RuntimeError("DNS forbidden in isolated MySQL runner")
    if event == "socket.connect" and args[1] != str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock"):
        raise RuntimeError("Only this newly created private Unix socket is allowed")


sys.addaudithook(guard)


def run(args, **kwargs):
    return subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True, **kwargs)


try:
    image = json.loads(run(["docker", "image", "inspect", "mysql:8.0.39"], check=True).stdout)[0]
    report["image_id"] = image["Id"]
    init = "mysqld --initialize-insecure --datadir=/var/lib/mysql --innodb-buffer-pool-size=32M --innodb-redo-log-capacity=16777216 --log-error-verbosity=2 && exec mysqld --datadir=/var/lib/mysql --socket=/socket/mysql.sock --pid-file=/socket/mysql.pid --skip-networking --mysqlx=0 --skip-log-bin --performance-schema=OFF --innodb-buffer-pool-size=32M --innodb-redo-log-capacity=16777216 --secure-file-priv=NULL --log-error-verbosity=2"
    args = [
        "docker",
        "run",
        "-d",
        "--name",
        NAME,
        "--label",
        LABEL,
        "--network",
        "none",
        "--read-only",
        "--cap-drop",
        "ALL",
        "--security-opt",
        "no-new-privileges",
        "--user",
        "999:999",
        "--memory",
        "768m",
        "--cpus",
        "1",
        "--pids-limit",
        "128",
        "--tmpfs",
        "/var/lib/mysql:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=512m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0700",
        "--tmpfs",
        "/tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=64m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0700",
        "--mount",
        "type=bind,src=" + str(socket_dir) + ",dst=/socket",
        "--entrypoint",
        "sh",
        "mysql:8.0.39",
        "-c",
        init,
    ]
    run(args, check=True)
    info = json.loads(run(["docker", "inspect", NAME], check=True).stdout)[0]
    assert info["HostConfig"]["NetworkMode"] == "none" and not info["HostConfig"]["PortBindings"]
    assert info["HostConfig"]["ReadonlyRootfs"] and info["Config"]["User"] == "999:999"
    assert not any(m["Type"] == "volume" for m in info["Mounts"])
    report["isolation"] = {
        "network_mode": info["HostConfig"]["NetworkMode"],
        "port_bindings": info["HostConfig"]["PortBindings"],
        "readonly_root": True,
        "user": info["Config"]["User"],
        "cap_drop": info["HostConfig"]["CapDrop"],
        "tmpfs": info["HostConfig"]["Tmpfs"],
        "mount_types": [m["Type"] for m in info["Mounts"]],
    }
    import pymysql

    connection = None

        if (
            not run(
                ["docker", "inspect", "--format", "{{.State.Running}}", NAME],
                check=True,
            ).stdout.strip()

            connection = pymysql.connect(
                unix_socket=str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock"),
                user="root",
                charset="utf8mb4",
                connect_timeout=1,
                autocommit=True,
            )

    env = {
        "PATH": "/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin",
        "LANG": "C.UTF-8",
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        "DATABASE_URL": "mysql+pymysql://root@localhost/hoim_synthetic_operations_source?unix_socket=" + str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock") + "&charset=utf8mb4",
        "ENVIRONMENT": "test",
        "SECRET_KEY": "synthetic-supply-migration-only-" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
        "AUTO_CREATE_SCHEMA": "false",
        "SCHEDULER_ENABLED": "false",
    }
    result = run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            str(worker_copy),
            str(ROOT),
            str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock"),
            str(worker_result),
        ],
        cwd=work,
        env=env,
        timeout=600,
    )
    if worker_result.exists():
        report.update(json.loads(worker_result.read_text()))
    report["worker_exit_code"] = result.returncode
    report["worker_stdout"] = result.stdout[-2000:]
    report["worker_stderr"] = result.stderr[-4000:]
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("Verification worker failed; see recorded worker stderr and error")
    report["verification_script_sha256"] = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [Path(__file__), WORKER]}
except BaseException as exc:
    report["all_checks_passed"] = False
    report["runner_error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}
finally:
    removed = run(["docker", "rm", "-f", "-v", NAME])
    absent = run(["docker", "inspect", NAME]).returncode != 0
    own_volumes = run(
        [
            "docker",
            "volume",
            "ls",
            "--filter",
            "label=" + LABEL,
            "--format",
            "{{.Name}}",
        ]
    ).stdout.strip()
    shutil.rmtree(work)
    report["own_container_absent_verified"] = absent
    report["own_container_and_volumes_removed"] = absent and not own_volumes
    report["own_private_directory_removed"] = not work.exists()
    report["cleanup_verified"] = report["own_container_and_volumes_removed"] and report["own_private_directory_removed"]
    report["verification_scripts_retained_in_tmp"] = [str(Path(__file__)), str(WORKER)]
    report["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - START, 3)
    report["completed_at_utc"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat()
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
if report.get("all_checks_passed") and report["cleanup_verified"]:
    final = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-source-second-mysql-verification.json")
    assert not final.exists(), "Do not overwrite existing final bed MySQL evidence"
    shutil.copyfile(OUTPUT, final)
print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "artifact": str(OUTPUT),
            "all_checks_passed": report.get("all_checks_passed"),
            "cleanup_verified": report["cleanup_verified"],
            "seconds": report["seconds"],
            "runner_error": report.get("runner_error"),
            "error": report.get("error"),
        },
        ensure_ascii=False,
    )
)
sys.exit(0 if report.get("all_checks_passed") and report["cleanup_verified"] else 1)

"""Create one private non-networked MySQL instance and verify cleanup unconditionally."""

import datetime
import hashlib

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

START = time.monotonic()
ROOT = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-support-20261021/fastapi_be")
OUTPUT = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-task-first-mysql-attempt-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12] + ".json")
WORKER = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-task-mysql-first-worker.py")
NAME = "hoim-operations-task-first-mysql-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
LABEL = "hoim.operations.source=" + NAME
work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hoim-operations-task-first-mysql-private-"))
socket_dir = work / "socket"
socket_dir.mkdir()
socket_dir.chmod(0o777)
worker_copy = work / "worker.py"
shutil.copyfile(WORKER, worker_copy)
worker_result = work / "worker-result.json"
report = {
    "image": "mysql:8.0.39",
    "container_name": NAME,
    "synthetic_only": True,
    "network": "none",
    "host_ports": [],
    "source_mounts": False,
    "existing_database_accessed": False,
    "project_env_file_read": False,
    "scope": "Private MySQL six additive governed operations Source/Task tables and staged Task service; actual incremental up/down/up and every old DDL/row hash, current authority and direct/Source concurrency. No historical migration chain replay, HTTP/shared worker/model/hospital claim.",
}


def guard(event, args):
    if event == "open" and args and isinstance(args[0], (str, bytes)):
        name = Path(os.fsdecode(args[0])).name
        if name == ".env" or name.startswith(".env."):
            raise RuntimeError("Dotenv forbidden in isolated MySQL runner")
    if event == "socket.getaddrinfo":
        raise RuntimeError("DNS forbidden in isolated MySQL runner")
    if event == "socket.connect" and args[1] != str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock"):
        raise RuntimeError("Only this newly created private Unix socket is allowed")


sys.addaudithook(guard)


def run(args, **kwargs):
    return subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True, **kwargs)


try:
    image = json.loads(run(["docker", "image", "inspect", "mysql:8.0.39"], check=True).stdout)[0]
    report["image_id"] = image["Id"]
    init = "mysqld --initialize-insecure --datadir=/var/lib/mysql --innodb-buffer-pool-size=32M --innodb-redo-log-capacity=16777216 --log-error-verbosity=2 && exec mysqld --datadir=/var/lib/mysql --socket=/socket/mysql.sock --pid-file=/socket/mysql.pid --skip-networking --mysqlx=0 --skip-log-bin --performance-schema=OFF --innodb-buffer-pool-size=32M --innodb-redo-log-capacity=16777216 --secure-file-priv=NULL --log-error-verbosity=2"
    args = [
        "docker",
        "run",
        "-d",
        "--name",
        NAME,
        "--label",
        LABEL,
        "--network",
        "none",
        "--read-only",
        "--cap-drop",
        "ALL",
        "--security-opt",
        "no-new-privileges",
        "--user",
        "999:999",
        "--memory",
        "768m",
        "--cpus",
        "1",
        "--pids-limit",
        "128",
        "--tmpfs",
        "/var/lib/mysql:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=512m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0700",
        "--tmpfs",
        "/tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=64m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0700",
        "--mount",
        "type=bind,src=" + str(socket_dir) + ",dst=/socket",
        "--entrypoint",
        "sh",
        "mysql:8.0.39",
        "-c",
        init,
    ]
    run(args, check=True)
    info = json.loads(run(["docker", "inspect", NAME], check=True).stdout)[0]
    assert info["HostConfig"]["NetworkMode"] == "none" and not info["HostConfig"]["PortBindings"]
    assert info["HostConfig"]["ReadonlyRootfs"] and info["Config"]["User"] == "999:999"
    assert not any(m["Type"] == "volume" for m in info["Mounts"])
    report["isolation"] = {
        "network_mode": info["HostConfig"]["NetworkMode"],
        "port_bindings": info["HostConfig"]["PortBindings"],
        "readonly_root": True,
        "user": info["Config"]["User"],
        "cap_drop": info["HostConfig"]["CapDrop"],
        "tmpfs": info["HostConfig"]["Tmpfs"],
        "mount_types": [m["Type"] for m in info["Mounts"]],
    }
    import pymysql

    connection = None
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 75
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if (
            not run(
                ["docker", "inspect", "--format", "{{.State.Running}}", NAME],
                check=True,
            ).stdout.strip()
            == "true"
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Private MySQL exited during initialization: " + run(["docker", "logs", "--tail", "25", NAME]).stdout + run(["docker", "logs", "--tail", "25", NAME]).stderr)
        try:
            connection = pymysql.connect(
                unix_socket=str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock"),
                user="root",
                charset="utf8mb4",
                connect_timeout=1,
                autocommit=True,
            )
            break
        except (pymysql.err.OperationalError, FileNotFoundError):
            time.sleep(0.25)
    if connection is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Private MySQL did not become ready within bounded initialization wait")
    with connection:
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("CREATE DATABASE hoim_synthetic_operations_source CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci")
    report["waited_for_final_mysql_initialization"] = True
    env = {
        "PATH": "/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin",
        "LANG": "C.UTF-8",
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        "DATABASE_URL": "mysql+pymysql://root@localhost/hoim_synthetic_operations_source?unix_socket=" + str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock") + "&charset=utf8mb4",
        "ENVIRONMENT": "test",
        "SECRET_KEY": "synthetic-supply-migration-only-" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
        "AUTO_CREATE_SCHEMA": "false",
        "SCHEDULER_ENABLED": "false",
    }
    result = run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            str(worker_copy),
            str(ROOT),
            str(socket_dir / "mysql.sock"),
            str(worker_result),
        ],
        cwd=work,
        env=env,
        timeout=600,
    )
    if worker_result.exists():
        report.update(json.loads(worker_result.read_text()))
    report["worker_exit_code"] = result.returncode
    report["worker_stdout"] = result.stdout[-2000:]
    report["worker_stderr"] = result.stderr[-4000:]
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("Verification worker failed; see recorded worker stderr and error")
    report["verification_script_sha256"] = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [Path(__file__), WORKER]}
except BaseException as exc:
    report["all_checks_passed"] = False
    report["runner_error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}
finally:
    removed = run(["docker", "rm", "-f", "-v", NAME])
    absent = run(["docker", "inspect", NAME]).returncode != 0
    own_volumes = run(
        [
            "docker",
            "volume",
            "ls",
            "--filter",
            "label=" + LABEL,
            "--format",
            "{{.Name}}",
        ]
    ).stdout.strip()
    shutil.rmtree(work)
    report["own_container_absent_verified"] = absent
    report["own_container_and_volumes_removed"] = absent and not own_volumes
    report["own_private_directory_removed"] = not work.exists()
    report["cleanup_verified"] = report["own_container_and_volumes_removed"] and report["own_private_directory_removed"]
    report["verification_scripts_retained_in_tmp"] = [str(Path(__file__)), str(WORKER)]
    report["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - START, 3)
    report["completed_at_utc"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat()
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
if report.get("all_checks_passed") and report["cleanup_verified"]:
    final = Path("/tmp/hoim-operations-task-first-mysql-verification.json")
    assert not final.exists(), "Do not overwrite existing final bed MySQL evidence"
    shutil.copyfile(OUTPUT, final)
print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "artifact": str(OUTPUT),
            "all_checks_passed": report.get("all_checks_passed"),
            "cleanup_verified": report["cleanup_verified"],
            "seconds": report["seconds"],
            "runner_error": report.get("runner_error"),
            "error": report.get("error"),
        },
        ensure_ascii=False,
    )
)
sys.exit(0 if report.get("all_checks_passed") and report["cleanup_verified"] else 1)
